question: Does the deterministic depth-2 phantom first token (33rd sequential request, cache-c032, R165/R167b) disappear with --no-async-scheduling? Async scheduling makes the model runner hand sampled tokens to the scheduler through a non-blocking device-to-host copy synchronized by a torch.cuda.Event shim (blocking flag dropped on XPU) and feeds the next step from a GPU-side copy of the sampled token; a stale host read would show a wrong token in the output stream while the model continues from the true token, which is exactly the R165 signature (phantom then the MTP0 sequence).
method: same 64-prompt sequential pass on a 256/64/512 depth-2 server with EXTRA_SERVE_ARGS=--no-async-scheduling
decision: phantom gone -> async output path race on XPU (then check whether depth 1 shares the latent defect and decide the fix: synchronize the copy or run async off); phantom persists -> bookkeeping/backup-token path, instrument with a logging image
